M-STATIC-BEHAVIOR.Purpose: Immediate or delayed target assignment: capture a plain value as a behavior that reaches its target instantly or after a delay.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: StaticBehavior<T> target capture with optional delay window.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Static facade helper for authoring immediate values. Interpolation over time — owned by M-TWEEN-BEHAVIOR and M-SPRING-BEHAVIOR.

Requirements.REQ-001: Activation is idempotent while active: repeated Activate leaves State Active and fires OnActivate exactly once.
Requirements.REQ-002: While active, Update reports progress proportional to elapsed/Duration via OnUpdate and completes exactly once after Duration elapses.
Requirements.REQ-003: With zero or negative Duration, Activate never enters the updating state and no progress is reported.
Requirements.REQ-004: Reset returns the behavior to Inactive, clears Duration/elapsed and detaches all handlers.
Requirements.REQ-005: SemEquals compares Target and Duration semantics; Clone yields an independent equal instance.

Inputs.IN-002: delay: float — seconds to wait before assignment (default 0).

Outputs.OUT-001: State — Finished once the assignment has occurred.
